content.short: Checker gives financial institutions access to many payment providers through one integration.
content.description: Checker aggregates payment and liquidity providers behind a single integration for financial institutions, so adding a corridor or a provider does not mean another bespoke connection. Monad's documentation lists it under payment orchestrators. Orchestration layers of this kind tend to appear once institutions have accumulated enough direct integrations to find them unmanageable.
